content:
Apple today released a new version of the Apple Invites app for iPhone. This update takes full advantage of new features in iOS 27, including improved photo sharing and Image Playground capabilities.

The following is Apple's full release notes for today's Apple Invites update:

  • Shared Albums now support full-resolution sharing, allowing you to relive every moment in the app with exceptional detail. Anyone can join and contribute, including users without an Apple device.
  • Image Playground can now help you create high-quality backgrounds in nearly any style, including photorealistic, so your invitations can perfectly capture the atmosphere you envision.
  • Guests who need to verify their email can now tap a link in their inbox instead of entering a verification code, making it easier to join events.
  • This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.

You can download Apple Invites from the App Store. An iCloud+ subscription is required to create invitations, but anyone can RSVP.
